narratives.title: Geopolitical Escalation Risk-Off
narratives.summary: Capital is fleeing risk assets as multi-front conflicts (Iran, Israel, Ukraine) escalate beyond controlled tit-for-tat, with actual kinetic exchanges and supply disruptions. The market consensus underestimates the persistence and breadth of these threats, driving flows into safe havens.
narratives.trade_implication: Short equities (S&P 500) and long gold or VIX; overweight cash and short-duration Treasuries.

narratives.title: Oil Supply Disruption Premium
narratives.summary: Capital is pricing in a sustained oil supply disruption from the Strait of Hormuz blockade and strategic reserve releases, with EIA forecasts showing a prolonged impact through 2026. The market misreads SPR releases as bearish, but they signal government preparation for structural shortages.
narratives.trade_implication: Long WTI crude oil futures and energy sector ETFs; short refined product spreads.

narratives.title: Diplomatic Mirage vs. Reality
narratives.summary: Capital is caught between hopes of diplomatic off-ramps (Iran deal, Lebanon ceasefire) and actual military preparations (IDF readiness, evacuation orders). The contradiction creates volatility, with flows hedging against both outcomes but leaning bearish as diplomatic progress appears fragile.
narratives.trade_implication: Long volatility via VIX calls or straddles on oil and equity indices; avoid directional bets on Middle East proxies.
